subject: Last days: 20% off Algotraders24 products ends 14 Nov
preheader: Code DIWALI20 is still active. The Diwali offer ends on 14 November.
bodyText:
Hi,

A quick reminder: our Diwali offer is still running, and it ends on **14 November 2026**.

**The offer**

- Code: **DIWALI20**
- 20% off every Expert Advisor and indicator on the Algotraders24 marketplace (MT4, MT5 and TradingView)
- Valid until 14 November 2026, 11:59 PM Indian time
- Works with card and crypto payments

**How to use it**

- Open any product page and sign in
- Type DIWALI20 in the promo code box above the Buy button and press Apply
- Your new price shows right away

If you have been thinking about a tool, now is a good time to look at it calmly. Every listing page shows its evidence and its limits openly, so you can choose what fits your own style. We suggest starting on a demo account with a small risk setting.

And if you are still learning, our free lessons on YouTube continue every day, so there is always something new.

Thank you for being part of the Algotraders24 community.

Warm regards,
The Algotraders24 team

Questions? Just reply to this email and our support team will help.
